verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no enrollment status values for expired or revoked connections and no re-authentication or update flow in Teller Connect. The only related item is the general statement that webhook events fire on 'conditions or changes' in enrollments, which names no broken-connection status and no repair path. That is too vague to count as documented support for this story.

support.subject: As an ops lead, broken connections are repairable — expired or revoked links surface as documented statuses, and users can re-authenticate in an update flow without starting over
